{{External|rs|rsc=Black Plate Mail Legs|dw=Black Knight Platelegs}} {{Infobox Item |name = Black platelegs |image = [[File:Black platelegs.png]] |release = [[28 February]] [[2001]] |update = Yet another new quest, and new options menu |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wear, Drop |examine = Big, black and heavy looking. |value = 1920 |weight = 9.071 |exchange = Yes |id = 1077 }} [[File:Black_platelegs_detail.png|left|90px]] '''Black platelegs''' have the same bonuses as the [[black plateskirt]] but weigh more. They require level 10 [[Defence]] to wear. They can be bought from [[Louie's Armoured Legs Bazaar]] in [[Al Kharid]] or [[Valaine's Shop of Champions.|Valaine's Shop of Champions]] in the [[Champions' Guild]]. Like all other [[black armour]], it cannot be made with the [[Smithing]] [[Skills|skill]]. Black platelegs are used in [[King's Ransom]] and [[Heroes' Quest]] if you're part of the [[Black Arm Gang]]. [[Black platelegs (t)]] and [[Black platelegs (g)|(g)]] can both be obtained as a reward from [[Clue scroll (easy)|easy]] [[Treasure Trails]]. They provide no extra bonuses than regular black platelegs other than being aesthetically improved. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = -21 |arange = -11 |dstab = 21 |dslash = 20 |dcrush = 19 |dmagic = -4 |drange = 20 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = legs |image = [[File:Black platelegs equipped male.png|170px]] |altimage = [[File:Black platelegs equipped female.png|150px]] }} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Black platelegs}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Black platelegs}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 21 April 2021 |update = Fishing Trawler Improvements and Equipment Rebalance: Part One |change = The platelegs's ranged attack bonus has been decreased from -7 to -11. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Black platelegs detail (beta).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Black platelegs detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Black platelegs (beta).png|center]] |[[File:Black platelegs.png|center]] |- |RuneScape 2
